description_en: Retrieves the details of a configuration set
name: ConfigSetDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the configuration set. This parameter is required
parameters.name: id

Id.description_en: The ID of the configuration set

IpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the associated IP pool

IpPoolName.description_en: The name of the associated IP pool

IsPublicChannelBackoff.description_en:
Specifies whether to fall back to the public channel for sending when an issue occurs with the associated dedicated IP pool.

true (Fallback): During each delivery, the system excludes dedicated IPs that are throttled or blacklisted by the destination mailbox provider, and prioritizes other available IPs in the pool. If all IPs in the pool are throttled or blacklisted by the provider, the system automatically switches to the public channel to ensure delivery success. The system automatically resumes using dedicated IPs after the throttling or blacklisting is lifted.
false (No fallback): The system uses only the associated dedicated IP pool for sending. If IPs in the pool are throttled or blacklisted, the system continues to use them for delivery, which may cause delivery failures or delays, but ensures that the sending IP is always your dedicated IP
IsPublicChannelBackoff.description_zh:
关联的独立 IP 池出现问题时，是否退避使用公共通道发送。

true（退避）：系统在每次投递时会剔除当前对目标邮箱服务商被流控或列黑的独立 IP，优先使用池内其余可用 IP 发送；当池内 IP 对该邮箱服务商全部被流控或列黑时，自动改用公共通道发送，保障投递成功率。流控或列黑解除后自动恢复使用独立 IP。
false（不退避）：仅使用关联的独立 IP 池发送；池内 IP 被流控或列黑时仍继续使用这些 IP 投递，可能导致投递失败或延迟，但可确保发信 IP 始终为您的独立 IP

Name.description_en: The name of the configuration set

Enabled.description_en:
Specifies whether the address validation feature is enabled.

true: Enabled. This corresponds to the BASIC_ONLY mode of the ValidateEmail operation.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
地址校验功能是否启用。

true：启用。是地址校验接口ValidateEmail 接口的BASIC_ONLY模式。
false：不启用

ForbiddenStatusList.description_en: The list of primary recipient address validation statuses to block. Before sending an email, the system pre-validates the recipient address. Emails whose primary validation status matches a status in this list are rejected
ForbiddenStatusList.description_zh: 需要拦截的收件人地址校验主状态列表。发信前系统对收件人地址做预校验，校验结果主状态命中本列表的邮件将被拒绝发送

items.description_en:
The primary recipient address validation status to block. Valid values:
INVALID: Invalid address or the address does not exist.
CATCH_ALL: Catch-all address. Any mailbox under the domain can receive emails, and it cannot be determined whether the address actually exists.
DO_NOT_MAIL: The address can receive emails but sending is not recommended, such as role accounts or disposable email addresses.
UNKNOWN: The validation result cannot be provided
items.description_zh:
需要拦截的收件人地址校验主状态。取值：
INVALID: 无效地址或地址不存在。
CATCH_ALL: Catch-all地址，域名下任意邮箱均可收信，无法确定地址真实存在。
DO_NOT_MAIL：可收信但不建议发送，如角色账号/一次性邮箱。
UNKNOWN：无法提供校验结果

ForbiddenSubStatusList.description_en: The list of secondary recipient address validation statuses to block. This list provides more fine-grained blocking control than primary statuses and takes effect as a union with ForbiddenStatusList. An email is blocked if its status matches any status in either list
ForbiddenSubStatusList.description_zh: 需要拦截的收件人地址校验子状态列表，提供比主状态更细粒度的拦截控制，与 ForbiddenStatusList 取并集生效（命中任一列表即拦截）

items.description_en:
The secondary recipient address validation status to block. Valid values:
NO_DNS_ENTRIES: Invalid address. No DNS records found.
MISSPELLED: Invalid address. Misspelled.
DOES_NOT_ACCEPT_MAIL: Invalid address. The mail server does not accept emails.
MAILBOX_NOT_EXISTS: Invalid address. The mailbox does not exist.
SYSTEM_ERROR: Unknown status. System error.
MX_FORWARD: Abnormal address. MX forwarding.
SYNTAX_INVALID: Invalid address. Syntax error.
ROLE_ACCOUNT: Abnormal address. Role account, such as role@, info@, or contact@.
SMTP_CONNECT_FAILED: Unknown status. Failed to connect to the recipient's SMTP server.
DISABLED: Invalid address. The mailbox is disabled.
UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified. Valid, catch-all, or unknown status may be returned.
IP_UNROUTABLE: Invalid address. The IP address of the mail server is unreachable.
GRAY_LIST: Unknown status. Graylist.
MAILBOX_FULL: Invalid address. The mailbox is full.
DISPOSABLE: Abnormal address. Disposable email address or in a blacklist.
TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED: Unknown status. The specified timeout period is exceeded.

Passing an unknown value returns InvalidParameter
items.description_zh:
需要拦截的收件人地址校验子状态。取值：
NO_DNS_ENTRIES : 无效地址，没有 DNS 记录。
MISSPELLED : 无效地址，拼写错误。
DOES_NOT_ACCEPT_MAIL : 无效地址，邮件服务器不接受邮件。
MAILBOX_NOT_EXISTS : 无效地址，邮箱不存在。
SYSTEM_ERROR : 未知状态，系统错误。
MX_FORWARD : 非正常地址，MX 转发。
SYNTAX_INVALID : 无效地址，语法错误。
ROLE_ACCOUNT : 非正常地址，角色账号，比如 role@ info@ contact@ 等。
SMTP_CONNECT_FAILED : 未知状态，连接对方 SMTP 服务器失败。
DISABLED : 无效地址，邮箱已被禁用。
UNSPECIFIED : 没有说明，有效、CatchAll、未知状态可能返回。
IP_UNROUTABLE : 无效地址，邮件服务器 IP 不可达。
GRAY_LIST : 未知状态，灰名单
MAILBOX_FULL : 无效地址，邮箱已满
DISPOSABLE : 非正常地址，临时邮箱，黑名单库。
TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED : 未知状态，超过指定的超时时间。

传入未知取值将返回 InvalidParameter
